description_en: Applies the configuration of a PVW scene to a PGM scene
description_zh: 将原场景配置应用至目标场景并生效，仅限PVW场景配置拷贝至PGM场景
kebab_example: aliyun live copy-caster-scene-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --from-scene-id f1a361f4-bee3-436d-ae6e-d38e69430000 --to-scene-id 05ab713c-676e-49c0-96ce-cc408da10000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyCasterSceneConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page. The ID of the production studio is in the Instance ID/Name column.

The production studio name in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page of the ApsaraVideo Live console is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source scene. The scene must be a PVW scene
parameters.name: from_scene_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination scene. The scene must be a PGM scene
parameters.name: to_scene_id
